title: A plug-in energy-balance freezing module for transformer frost nowcasting without leaf-sensor inputs
abstract: arXiv:2611.20114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frost protection requires local warnings where leaf-sensor inputs are unavailable. In the frost literature we surveyed, physics entered machine-learning models through inputs, numerical-model coupling, or losses, rather than model structure. We develop a transformer-compatible module that embeds leaf energy-balance physics in freezing-probability forecasts: an energy-balance temperature reference and a learned residual predict leaf temperature, which drives a multiplicative gate imposing a temperature-dependent probability cap. We mathematically prove conditional monotonicity and an alarm boundary, and test whether placing the same information in the output pathway or in attention yields different benefits. We evaluated 12 hourly leads at 19 Korean stations over five frost seasons, with and without leaf-sensor inputs. In the 2025-2026 hold-out season without these inputs, our time-token transformer (PET-E) achieved a lead-mean critical

translated_title: 一种无需叶片传感器输入的即插即用能量平衡结冰模块，用于Transformer霜冻临近预报
translated_abstract: 霜冻防护需要在无法获得叶片传感器输入的情况下进行本地化预警。在我们调研的霜冻相关文献中，物理知识是通过输入、数值模式耦合或损失函数进入机器学习模型的，而非通过模型结构本身。我们开发了一个与Transformer兼容的模块，将叶片能量平衡物理嵌入结冰概率预报中：由能量平衡温度参考项与一个可学习的残差共同预测叶片温度，该温度进而驱动一个乘性门控，施加依赖于温度的概率上限。我们从数学上证明了条件单调性与警报边界，并检验了将相同信息置于输出通路或注意力机制中是否会带来不同的收益。我们在韩国19个站点、五个霜冻季上评估了12个逐小时预报时效，分别在有和没有叶片传感器输入的情况下进行测试。在无这些输入的2025-2026保留测试季中，我们的时间token Transformer（PET-E）在各预报时效平均上达到了临界（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出一种即插即用的能量平衡结冰模块，将叶片能量平衡物理直接嵌入Transformer的模型结构中，在无需叶片传感器输入的条件下实现可靠的霜冻结冰概率临近预报。
en_tdlr: A plug-in energy-balance module embeds leaf energy-balance physics directly into a transformer's model structure, enabling reliable frost freezing-probability nowcasting without leaf-sensor inputs.
